title: Work UI: show label groups as a compact overview before expanding tasks
outcome: A person opening Labels in the TermAl Work panel can choose an area and see which group needs attention before reading individual tasks.
acceptance: Labels initially shows collapsed, readable group headings with counts calculated from the already filtered rows, including how many tasks are blocked.
Opening a heading reveals its existing tasks and inline details. A task selected through another Work view remains reachable when switching to Labels.
Labels retains existing filters, multi-label grouping, and Engram read behavior.
